claim: R2 GC OFF/ON improves median completion at fixed C20/w32
evidence: 10 primary receipts, status CSVs, score-reference checks and matching sealed outputs
falsifier_or_limit: New stronger controls may absorb the speed difference; five repeats are not independent corpora

claim: The 118 OFF rescues are capacity failures
evidence: reason=2 for the same 118 IDs in every OFF run; ON reason=0 for all 9112 eligible pairs
falsifier_or_limit: Do not merge E8192 execution failures, C3/2GiB zero-failure runs or native allocation failures

claim: 13.5% measures pure collector cost or hardware speed
evidence: GC changes continued GPU work, CPU restart, pipeline overlap and output readiness
falsifier_or_limit: Any interpretation as additive collector/rescue seconds is invalid under these measurements

claim: Previous-batch CPU work can gate later submissions
evidence: direct helper call before result copy/next loop; OFF batch0 callback 10.815s; batch1->2 pair envelope gap 5.605s
falsifier_or_limit: Missing new queue intervention; pair gap is not proof that every GPU engine was idle

claim: An asynchronous rescue queue will beat GC
evidence: No QUEUED arm exists in the audited R2 records
falsifier_or_limit: Exact bounded-resource 2x2; account for snapshot copies, queue pressure, CPU interference and final drain

claim: Ordinary rescue load balancing may absorb some benefit
evidence: batch0 thread rescue times 10.146/10.794/4.925/2.874s; fixed-duration replay only
falsifier_or_limit: Native dynamic(1) qualification; replay durations change with scheduling and interference

claim: Active-root mark/compact/remap is a new principle
falsifier_or_limit: Contribution must specify a concrete new GPU mechanism beyond existing reachability and relocation

claim: Persistent worker scheduling, compressed traceback and overlapped rescue are new
falsifier_or_limit: Queue decoupling may be a stronger baseline; merely adding a task queue is not a new alignment principle

claim: Shared-pool memory reuse itself establishes novelty
evidence: Generic GPU allocation and CUDA stream-ordered pools already reuse allocations
falsifier_or_limit: A host CUDA pool does not discover DAG liveness inside a persistent kernel. Need safe within-kernel ownership/reclamation and same-cap native witness; no claim of functional identity between API pool and traceback collector

claim: Budget-aware recomputation or fewer stored traceback states is new
evidence: BiWFA, wfalm/miniwfa and Singletrack; TALCO convergence under its banding conditions
falsifier_or_limit: Match global affine/full-CIGAR guarantees and support before timing; do not present banded or score-only output as equivalent exact baseline
